title: NASA: Space Race Milestones
description: Rockets, astronauts, and the push beyond our planet—five space-program depths.

questions.question: NASA—the National Aeronautics and Space Administration—sent who as the first American to orbit Earth in 1962?
questions.hint: His first name is John, and he later became a U.S. Senator

questions.question: After Glenn's 1962 orbit, what NASA program successfully landed humans on the Moon?
questions.hint: Named after a Greek god, this program achieved Kennedy's goal of lunar landing

questions.question: NASA's Apollo glory gave way to tragedy—which space shuttle broke apart 73 seconds after launch in 1986?
questions.hint: It carried teacher Christa McAuliffe and was named after a British naval research vessel

questions.question: After Challenger, NASA kept pushing outward—what Mars rover landed in 2021 searching for ancient life?
questions.hint: Named for the quality of continuing despite difficulties, nicknamed 'Percy'

imageHint: 🚀 One giant leap for mankind and beyond 🌙

questions.question: 'Failure is not an option' was written for the 1995 film Apollo 13—which flight director's character says it?
questions.hint: Played by Ed Harris, wearing a white vest

questions.question: NASA's Deep Space Network uses giant radio dishes to communicate with spacecraft. What is the diameter of the largest dishes?
questions.hint: About the length of a football field, these dishes can hear a whisper from billions of miles away
